clips.title: The story
paras: In south-central Ashenvale, Talondeep Vale lies between familiar landmarks and the road to the mountains.

Talondeep Vale lies beneath the trees of south-central Ashenvale. Silverwind Refuge stands to the east, and the Ruins of Stardust lie nearby. To the south, the land rises toward the Stonetalon Mountains. Travelers cross this wooded valley between the heart of Ashenvale and the high crags beyond.
